crash_definition: a Gemini server close (close_code set, e.g. 1011/1008). Sessions that failed LOCALLY before reaching the server (connect_failed, e.g. a local ConnectionResetError) are EXCLUDED from n and crash -- they are not server behavior.

functionDeclarations.description: Update ONE field with user's provided value. Call immediately when user answers. Translate values to English. Use exact field_id from schema (with brackets if present). For radio/select fields: Use the 'value' from the option object shown in schema (e.g., if option shows '"Yes" (use value: P1_checkbox4[0])', send value: "P1_checkbox4[0]"'). For checkboxes: boolean (true/false). For text fields: string. Current section only.
functionDeclarations.name: update_form_fields

value.description: For radio/select: exact "value" from option object. For checkbox: the option value (or "true"/"false"). For text: string.

functionDeclarations.description: Check which fields are filled and their values. Acknowledge user first ('One moment while I check the form').
functionDeclarations.name: get_form_status

functionDeclarations.description: Navigate to a different section/part. Use the section NUMBER only (e.g., '2' for Section 2).
functionDeclarations.name: switch_section

section_identifier.description: Section number as a string (e.g., '1', '2', '3'). ALWAYS use numbers, not labels.

functionDeclarations.description: Look up field value by EXACT spoken name from schema or previous sections. Match exact name shown in context - do not abbreviate.
functionDeclarations.name: get_field_value

functionDeclarations.description: Confirm that a field value is correct after user verification. MUST be called before moving to next field. After filling a field with update_form_fields, ask user 'Is that correct?' and wait for confirmation (yes/correct/that's right). If confirmed, call this tool. If user says no/incorrect, ask for correct value.
functionDeclarations.name: confirm_field

field_id.description: ID of the field being confirmed

confirmation_method.description: How the field was confirmed (verbal: user said yes/correct, manual: user edited field)
